description: OurWPG Airport Area is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. Airport Area policies, described in section F1 of Complete Communities 2.0, support the economic role of Winnipeg JAR International Airport and surrounding lands. Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category City Planning. Its tags are our winnipeg, ourwpg, ourwinnipeg, airport. The table has 2 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
